title: Durable mechanical circulatory support
scope: Generic class mechanism in representative anatomy. The anatomy, device shape and positions shown are representative of this class; they are not measured on a specific patient or population, and not a specific product. Schematic, not to scale; poses do not predict clinical fit, deformation, performance or flow.
stageLabel: Schematic · representative anatomy · not to scale
attribution: Whole-heart context adapted from Toronto Heart Atlas by Azad Mashari, Joshua Qua Hiansen, Mini Pakkal, Eitan Aziza, Ryan Ramos, Sachin Khargie and Massimiliano Meineri (CC BY 4.0). Display smoothing, vessel continuations and edits for readability are modifications. Detailed tissue shells, defects, device shapes and positions are representative schematics. They are not measured on a specific patient or population, and are not segmented tissue or clinical simulations.

views.label: Whole heart
views.title: Locate the treatment region
views.lesson: Use the highlighted region to orient the enlarged views.

views.label: Chambers and connections
views.title: Place the pump in left-heart context
views.lesson: Seen from the front and left, the left ventricle is opened to show its cavity. The pump sits at the ventricular apex with its inflow inside the cavity, and the outflow graft runs in front of the right ventricle to the ascending aorta. The chambers come from a real heart model with walls added. The pump, graft and their course are representative and are not measured on a specific patient or population.

views.label: Mechanism section
views.title: See the tissue–device relationship
views.lesson: Trace the connection from the ventricular cavity into the pump, then along the graft to the artery.

views.label: Oblique detail
views.title: Understand depth and attachment
views.lesson: An oblique view separates the near surface, device and supporting tissue.

views.label: Alternate section
views.title: See the relationship from another side
views.lesson: This alternate view keeps the same representative geometry and state.

location.label: TREATMENT LOCATION
location.body: The highlighted region locates this class in the heart. The marker is enlarged for orientation.

wall.label: LEFT VENTRICULAR CAVITY
wall.body: The representative wall has a basal inlet toward the mitral junction and a prepared apical opening for this lesson. It is not untreated native anatomy.

inflow.label: APICAL INFLOW
inflow.body: The short inflow segment enters the cavity through a representative apical opening.

pump.label: GENERIC PUMP HOUSING
pump.body: The housing marks the pump location. No specific rotor, motor, controller or product design is represented.

outflow.label: OUTFLOW GRAFT
outflow.body: The graft runs outside the chamber to the illustrated ascending artery. Arrows, flow rates and pressure effects are intentionally absent.

region_LV.label: LEFT VENTRICLE
region_LV.body: The front of the left ventricle is cut away to show its cavity. The mitral inlet from the left atrium sits at the top of the cavity, and the apical opening sits at the tip.

region_LA.label: LEFT ATRIUM
region_LA.body: The left atrium sits behind and above the left ventricle and fills it through the mitral inlet.

region_AO.label: ASCENDING AORTA
region_AO.body: The aorta leaves the left ventricle and rises in front of the atria. The graft joins its front wall; the joining point is representative.

region_RV.label: RIGHT VENTRICLE
region_RV.body: The right ventricle lies in front of and to the right of the left ventricle. The graft passes in front of it on the way to the aorta.

region_inflow.label: INFLOW IN THE APEX
region_inflow.body: The short inflow tube passes through the apical opening into the left ventricular cavity. Its depth and angle are representative and are not measured on a specific patient or population.

region_pump.label: GENERIC PUMP HOUSING
region_pump.body: The housing sits against the outside of the apex. No specific rotor, motor, controller or product design is represented.

region_outflow.label: OUTFLOW GRAFT
region_outflow.body: The graft runs outside the heart from the pump to the ascending aorta. Its course is representative and is not measured on a specific patient or population.
